entities.name: Dragonsoul Knight
entities.description: An unremarkable human warrior of Jund who, fleeing the Conflux, crossed all five shards of Alara and unleashed a dragon-like power within himself.

entities.name: Zarratha
entities.description: A lich lord from the necropolis of Unx in Grixis whose army harvested the souls of the knight's clanmates and whom dragonfire finally destroyed.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A strangely dressed shaman, a planeswalker who seemed to know dragons' minds, who briefly visited the knight's clan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An exceptionally ancient and powerful planeswalker and dragon behind secret propaganda in Jund.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: An elementalist shaman of Jund who urged spreading the warriors' Life Hunts into foreign shards.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: A warrior champion who leads the clan Tol Antaga.

entities.name: Tol Antaga
entities.description: A human warrior clan of Jund led by Kresh the Bloodbraided.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The collision of Alara's shards that broke the lands apart and slid them into one another.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: A swirling node of mana where all five shards of Alara overlap.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane of five shards, here at war and in upheaval.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara of volcanoes, hellkites, warrior clans and a teeming predator-web.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara of necromancy and the undead.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara of jungles, elves and lion-folk.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara of meadows and sea, home to knights, rhoxes and bird-men.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara where blue mana is strongest, with grid-lined realms and etherium armies.

entities.name: Unx
entities.description: A necropolis in Grixis from which Zarratha came.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: An archangel whose old prophecies Bant mages reread.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An Urborg mage of the Time Spiral novels who became adept at instantaneous travel within Dominaria before his spark ignited.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic, senseless void between the planes that planeswalkers brave.

events.summary: The Conflux strikes Jund, breaking the land with lava, raising black towers and sliding Jund into neighboring worlds.
events.quote: The lands of Jund sloughed off at the edges, sliding into new adjacent worlds

events.summary: The knight rides to rescue his clanmates but finds them floating, their souls seeping out.
events.quote: He found them floating in the air, their mortal souls seeping out of their bodies.

events.summary: Zarratha's army invades Jund and harvests the clanmates' souls as fuel; the knight flees rather than charge.
events.quote: The souls of the knight's clanmates became fuel for the lich's undead forces, their vis harvested like mere wheat.

events.summary: The knight flees away from Grixis into the lands that become Naya.
events.quote: Grixis was everywhere. So the knight fled in the other direction.

events.summary: In Naya the knight sees white mana, never known in Jund, in the Nacatl and elves.
events.quote: He saw it in the fighting styles of the Nacatl lion-folk

events.summary: Crossing Bant, the knight recalls Sarkhan Vol and begins to have night-terrors of a dragon bursting from his body.
events.quote: They were night-terrors in which his body tore apart, revealing a fledgling dragon inside

events.summary: The knight rides into Esper, where blue mana is strongest.
events.quote: The knight headed on, into Esper, where the call of blue mana was strongest

events.summary: The knight rides into Grixis, completing his circuit, and recognizes the world that spawned Zarratha.
events.quote: He recognized the home-world that spawned Zarratha, the lich who harvested the souls of his clanmates.

events.summary: The knight fights through Grixis and finds his dead clanmates forming Zarratha's front lines.
events.quote: No. Dead. Forming the front lines for the lich Zarratha.

events.summary: Using mana he never understood, the knight unleashes dragonfire, Zarratha perishes, and he cremates his friends and returns home to found a new warrior-clan.
events.quote: It's the story of how the lich Zarratha perished under a siege of dragonfire

relations.note: Zarratha perished under dragonfire in the knight's story.
relations.quote: It's the story of how the lich Zarratha perished under a siege of dragonfire

relations.note: Zarratha is from Unx in Grixis.
relations.quote: a lich lord from the necropolis of Unx, shard of Grixis

relations.note: Possibly the knight's clan, led by the warrior champion.
relations.quote: possibly the clan Tol Antaga led by the warrior champion Kresh the Bloodbraided

relations.note: Her urgings were Bolas's secret propaganda.
relations.quote: the secret propaganda of the dragon Nicol Bolas
